item.subject: science
item.stem: In her school laboratory, Meena measures the density of mustard oil as 0.91 g/cm³. The density of water at the same temperature is 1.0 g/cm³. She divides the two values to find the relative density of the oil. Which statement about the relative density is correct?

options.A: It is 0.91, with no unit, because it compares the oil's density with the density of water.
options.B: It is 0.91 g/cm³, because relative density is just another way of writing density.
options.C: It is 1.1, with no unit, because water's density must be divided by the oil's density.
options.D: It is 0.91 g, because the unit of volume cancels out when the densities are divided.
